final_object: Precio de venta del control remoto
final_content: Se establece un precio de venta de 25 euros
content_en: A selling price of 25 euros is set.

final_content: Se plantea que el control remoto sea compacto, multifuncional y con un diseño diferenciado
content_en: It is proposed that the remote control be compact, multifunctional and have a distinctive design.

final_content: Se decide incorporar un mecanismo para ayudar a localizar el control remoto
content_en: It is decided to include a mechanism to help locate the remote control.

final_content: Se descarta controlar todos los dispositivos del hogar y se decide acotar el alcance del dispositivo
content_en: Controlling all household devices is ruled out and it is decided to narrow the scope of the device.

final_content: Se decide eliminar la función de teletexto
content_en: It is decided to remove the teletext function.

final_content: Se decide mantener la imagen corporativa utilizando los colores y el diseño corporativo en el control
content_en: It is decided to maintain the corporate image by using the corporate colors and design on the remote.

final_content: Se define como público objetivo general a todos los usuarios poseedores de un televisor
content_en: The target audience is defined broadly as all users who own a television.

final_content: Se decide que el producto tenga un diseño llamativo, colorido, moderno, resistente y compacto, con botones pulsadores y funciones complementarias
content_en: It is decided that the product will have an eye-catching, colorful, modern, sturdy and compact design, with push buttons and complementary functions.

final_content: Se decide utilizar baterías como fuente de energía que se ajustan a Presupuesto
content_en: It is decided to use batteries as the power source, ones that fit the budget.

final_content: Se decide condicionar la inclusión del reconocimiento de voz por tema de costo
content_en: It is decided to make the inclusion of speech recognition conditional on cost.

final_object: Forma y colores del control remoto
final_content: Se decide dar al control remoto forma de caracol con colores vivos
object_en: shape and colors of the remote control
content_en: It is decided to give the remote control a snail shape with bright colors.

final_content: Se establece que el control remoto tendrá un tamaño y formato compacto
content_en: It is established that the remote control will have a compact size and format.

final_content: Se decide incluir una base para el control remoto con forma de concha
content_en: It is decided to include a shell-shaped base for the remote control.

final_object: Materiales de la carcasa y de los botones
final_content: Se decide fabricar la carcasa en plástico y los botones en goma
content_en: It is decided to make the casing out of plastic and the buttons out of rubber.

final_content: Se incluye un botón de encendido y apagado para el control remoto
content_en: An on/off button is included for the remote control.

final_content: Se incluyen botones de silenciamiento para silenciar el televisor
content_en: Mute buttons are included to silence the television.

final_content: Se incluyen nueve botones numéricos (del 1 al 9) para la selección directa de canales
content_en: Nine numeric buttons (1 to 9) are included for direct channel selection.

final_content: Se incluyen dos botones para aumentar y disminuir el volumen
content_en: Two buttons are included to raise and lower the volume.

final_content: Se incluyen dos botones para desplazarse hacia arriba y hacia abajo entre los canales
content_en: Two buttons are included to move up and down between channels.

final_content: Se incluye un botón de menú en el centro para controlar color, nitidez y brillo de la imagen
content_en: A menu button is included in the center to control the color, sharpness and brightness of the picture.

final_content: Se incluye un botón flexible para alternar rápidamente entre el canal actual y el canal visto anteriormente
content_en: A flexible button is included to quickly switch between the current channel and the previously watched channel.

final_object: Rotulación e identificación de los botones
final_content: Se decide que los botones de canales lleven números y el resto de los botones tengan símbolos que indiquen su función
content_en: It is decided that the channel buttons will carry numbers and the remaining buttons will have symbols indicating their function.

final_content: Se decide incorporar una luz LED de color verde fluorescente
content_en: It is decided to include a fluorescent green LED light.

final_content: Se decide destinar el margen restante de 4,30 euros al reconocimiento de voz, aceptando el nivel de calidad que dicho monto permita
content_en: It is decided to allocate the remaining margin of 4.30 euros to speech recognition, accepting whatever level of quality that amount allows.
